title: Position Predicate
description: A PositionRule is a predicate (test) applied to the world block's position relative to the structure's world origin.

choices.title: Always True
choices.description: The test is skipped and assumed true.

choices.title: Axis Aligned Linear Position
choices.description: Validates a block based on its linear distance along a chosen axis from the structure's origin. max_chance must be greater than min_chance.

fields.title: Axis
fields.description: Axis along which to measure distance. Used by 'axis_aligned_linear_pos'.

fields.title: Min Chance
fields.description: Lower bound of the matching probability. Must be in [0, 1).

fields.title: Max Chance
fields.description: Upper bound of the matching probability. Must be in [0, 1) and greater than min_chance.

fields.title: Min Distance
fields.description: Minimum distance from the structure origin along the chosen axis. Must be greater than 0.

fields.title: Max Distance
fields.description: Maximum distance from the structure origin along the chosen axis. Must be greater than 0.
